pr_title: fix(python, rust): Initialize validity for `GroupsProxy::Slice` windows
pr_body:
Closes #15483

In the case of a `GroupsProxy::Slice`, validity wasn't getting set if a group had all of its items filtered out. Instead, uninitialized values would be used, leading to a mix of nulls and garbage values.

The other variant of `GroupsProxy`, the `GroupsProxy::Idx`, doesn't seem to have a problem when groups are filtered out entirely. To be safe, I left the initialization code before the `match` so it affects both variants.
pr_comments: Thank you for the fix @rob-sil. This can go in once CI is happy.

issue_context.title: `filter` + `arg_max` + `over` producing non-deterministic junk values
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "group": ["A", "A", "B", "B", "C", "C", "C", "C", "C"],
    "value": [2, 1, 0, 3, 2, 3, 5, 4, 4]
})

df.with_columns(pl.col("value").filter(False).arg_max().over("group"))

# shape: (9, 2)
# ┌───────┬────────────┐
# │ group ┆ value      │
# │ ---   ┆ ---        │
# │ str   ┆ u32        │
# ╞═══════╪════════════╡
# │ A     ┆ null       │
# │ A     ┆ null       │
# │ B     ┆ null       │
# │ B     ┆ 1          │
# │ C     ┆ 560934760  │
# │ C     ┆ 1          │
# │ C     ┆ 1894190896 │
# │ C     ┆ 1          │
# │ C     ┆ null       │
# └───────┴────────────┘
```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

`arg_max()` (and `arg_min()`) produce junk values when combined with `.filter()` and `.over()`

### Expected behavior

Return correct index.

### Installed versions

```
--------Version info---------
Polars:               0.20.18
Index type:           UInt32
Platform:             macOS-13.6.1-arm64-arm-64bit
```

comments: Looks like the operation isn't initializing the validity mask, which tracks the null values. The result should be all nulls, but if the validity mask is junk, then you'll get whatever is stored in the vectors values. In this case, it's just uninitialized junk like 1894190896.
